//go:build postingedgebench && darwin

package postingedge

// What the harness of the night reads of what an index keeps by doc id
// (bench_night_grow_test.go, bench_night_points_test.go), with the table by
// the vectors the index holds (doc_table.go).

// nightDeleted counts the vectors that are marked deleted.
func nightDeleted(g *growIndex) int {
	return g.deletedCount
}

// nightKeys is how many doc ids the table has room for: it has one room for
// the live vectors and the deleted ones.
func nightKeys(g *growIndex) (live, deleted int) {
	return g.docs.keys(), g.docs.keys()
}
